prompt:
Image 1 is the painting style reference only; do not copy its scenery.
Image 2 is the character design of LIN XIANGWAN (the woman, keep her face, eyes and fine wispy bangs; long straight black hair); in this picture LIN XIANGWAN is about 28 years old.
Image 3 is the character design of CHENG CHE (the man, keep his face and eyes; short slightly messy black hair); in this picture CHENG CHE is about 28 years old.

Scene: a hospital delivery room in the first minute after the birth, soft light, white sheets,
medical equipment blurred in the background. LIN XIANGWAN lies exhausted on the bed, hair damp with sweat, turning her face up toward him.
CHENG CHE stands beside the bed in a disposable hospital gown, leaning toward her; his eyes are completely red and wet, tears on his face.
Hands, written exactly: on the edge of the bed, her right hand is still squeezing his left hand hard after hours of pain. His left hand lies
palm down; her four fingers wrap over the back of his hand and her fingertips press into it, her thumb tucked under his palm. On the back of
his left hand, between her fingers, there are several small curved red fingernail marks. His right hand rests on the bed rail, mostly out
of frame. Only these two clasped hands are in the middle of the picture, clearly readable. Do not show the birth itself or the baby's body;
a nurse in the far background is holding a small wrapped bundle.

Painting style: delicate transparent watercolor on textured cold-press paper, exactly like image 1: pale luminous washes, soft natural light, loose soft wet edges, visible paper grain, unpainted white paper areas. Hand-painted watercolor illustration, not anime cel shading, not 3D, not photo.
Wide 16:9 landscape composition. Keep all important subjects and faces in the upper two thirds of the frame; the bottom third should be calm, low-detail ground or background (a text box will cover it). People do not look at the viewer unless stated. Correct anatomy: each hand has exactly five fingers, left and right hands on the correct sides; any hand not described is hidden out of view. Modern everyday objects look plain and timeless, nothing futuristic. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no brand names, no signage, no watermark.
